en.name: Jamón serrano, sliced
en.summary: Sliced serrano is the same ham as the leg it came from, but not the same food to store: slicing turns a small, dry, protected surface into a large, thin, freshly handled one. Unopened vacuum packs keep about 2–3 months refrigerated; once opened, 3–5 days. Frozen it runs 1–2 months. These are working limits borrowed from prosciutto and pre-packaged salami, not published serrano figures.
en.pantry: Sliced serrano is not a pantry item, even though the whole leg it was cut from is. The vacuum or modified-atmosphere pack it comes in is a refrigerated pack, and once you open it you have an opened ready-to-eat meat. Leave it out only to come up to temperature on the plate for a few minutes before serving, and put the rest back cold.
en.fridge: Unopened packs keep refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for about 2–3 months from purchase, or to the date on the pack. Lay them flat; a pack that has lost its vacuum and gone puffy goes back to the shop. After opening, the number that matters is 3–5 days: the ham dries, oxidises and browns fast, so re-wrap it tightly in film with the slices touching and eat it soon. Let it come to room temperature on the plate rather than in the packet.
en.freezer: A compromise at 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F): the fat oxidises and the texture goes waxy, so thawed slices belong in cooking rather than on a board. Freeze them interleaved with baking paper, bagged flat, with the air pressed out. Frozen food kept at −18 °C stays safe indefinitely; these months are a quality judgement rather than a documented limit.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, still wrapped, and use within a day or two. Never on the counter, and do not refreeze.
spoilage: Slices gone grey-brown and hard-edged all over rather than red with translucent fat.
A rancid, old-oil smell from the fat.
Slime or a tacky film on the slices.
A pack that was puffy or leaking before you opened it.
tips: Buy small packs; the opened window is the shortest number on this page.
Write the opening date on the pack — three to five days passes quickly.
Stack slices face to face when re-wrapping so less surface meets the air.
If you eat serrano slowly, buy a piece from the counter instead and slice as you go.

faq.q: How long does sliced serrano ham keep after opening?
faq.a: 3–5 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, tightly re-wrapped. That is far shorter than the leg it came from.

faq.q: Do unopened packs of serrano need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Yes. A sliced pack is a chilled product, about 2–3 months from purchase or to its printed date.

faq.q: Can you freeze sliced serrano ham?
faq.a: For 1–2 months, but it is a compromise: the fat oxidises and the slices thaw waxy. Use them in cooking.

faq.q: Why does sliced ham keep so much less time than a whole leg?
faq.a: A whole leg is dry, salty and protected on the outside. Slicing exposes a large thin surface, handled after curing, that both dries and picks up contamination easily.

zh.name: 西班牙生火腿切片
zh.summary: 切片的塞拉諾火腿和整支腿是同一塊肉，但在保存上完全不是同一件事：切片把一個小而乾燥、受保護的表面，變成一大片又薄又剛被經手過的新切面。未開封真空包冷藏約 2～3 個月；開封後 3～5 天；冷凍 1～2 個月。這些是比照生火腿與預包裝莎樂美腸推得的工作參考值，不是專為塞拉諾公布的數字。
zh.pantry: 就算它來自一支可以常溫吊掛的整腿，切片本身並不是常溫食品。它裝在真空包或充氣包裡，那是冷藏包裝；一旦拆封，你手上的就是一份「已開封的即食肉品」。只在上桌前讓它在盤子上回溫幾分鐘，其餘時間都放冷藏。
zh.fridge: 未開封的包裝放 4 °C 以下，從購買日起算約 2～3 個月，或以包裝標示日期為準。請平放；真空跑掉、包裝鼓起來的就拿回店家。開封後真正重要的數字是 3～5 天：火腿會迅速變乾、氧化、轉褐，所以要用保鮮膜緊緊重包、片與片貼合，並盡快吃完。要回溫請放在盤子上，不要留在袋子裡回溫。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 1～2 個月，是一種妥協：油脂氧化、口感變蠟，解凍後的切片比較適合入菜而不是擺冷盤。冷凍時用烘焙紙一片片隔開、平放裝袋壓出空氣。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，這裡的月數是判斷值，不是有出處的上限。
zh.thawing: 維持包裝放冷藏解凍，一兩天內用完。不要放室溫，也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 整片轉成灰褐、邊緣發硬，而不是紅肉配半透明油脂。
切片發黏、表面有一層黏膜。
還沒拆封就已經鼓起或滲液的包裝。
tips: 買小包裝；開封後的期限是這一頁上最短的數字。
在包裝上寫開封日——三到五天過得很快。
重新包裝時把切片面對面疊好，接觸空氣的面積才小。
吃得慢的話，改買整塊現切，要吃多少切多少。

faq.q: 西班牙生火腿切片開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下、重新包緊，3～5 天。比它來源的那支腿短得多。

faq.q: 未開封的火腿切片需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 需要。切片包是冷藏品，從購買日起算約 2～3 個月，或以包裝日期為準。

faq.q: 生火腿切片可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以放 1～2 個月，但是妥協：油脂會氧化、口感變蠟，建議拿去入菜。

faq.q: 為什麼切片比整支腿短那麼多？
faq.a: 整支腿又乾又鹹，外層還保護著內部。切片則製造出一大片薄薄的、熟成之後才被經手的表面，既容易乾掉也容易沾上污染。
